policies.title: Attendance & Finance Policies
policies.subtitle: Configure attendance punctuality rules, mobile QR check-in, and payroll exchange rates.
policies.attendanceDesc: Thresholds applied during daily attendance calculations and mobile check-ins.
policies.gracePeriodHint: Allowed buffer after shift start before an employee is marked late (0–180 minutes).
policies.enableQrAttendanceDesc: Allow employees to scan personal QR codes for check-in and check-out on mobile devices.
policies.financeDesc: Official payroll currency and conversion rate between US Dollar and Cambodian Riel.
policies.exchangeRateHint: Used when converting payroll totals and payslips between USD and KHR.
policies.summarySubtitle: Live operational rules applied to attendance & payroll

security.title: Attendance Security
security.subtitle: Control authorized Wi-Fi networks, GPS geofence boundaries, and scan verification logs.
security.networkModalDesc: Specify a static public IP address or CIDR subnet permitted for attendance check-ins.
security.wifiPolicyDesc: Mobile attendance requests are accepted only when traffic originates from an active authorized public IP or CIDR range listed below.
security.ipOrCidrHint: Provide at least an IP address or a CIDR subnet.
security.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional notes about this network or zone
security.noNetworksDesc: Add an organization public IP or CIDR subnet to enforce Wi-Fi verification.
security.geofenceModalDesc: Define center coordinates and allowed check-in radius in meters.
security.geofencePolicyDesc: Check-in distance is measured using the Haversine formula against active geofence coordinates. Devices must fall within the permitted radius and GPS accuracy threshold.
security.noGeofencesDesc: Add a GPS geofence zone to restrict mobile check-ins to physical premises.
security.noScanLogsDesc: Try adjusting your status, event, or date filters.
